text:
Lena (CitrineLabs): Hey CS team, CitrineLabs needs to onboard a custom summarization/rerank model trained on clinical notes (EN + DE + IT). Requesting Private deployment (VPC) with customer-managed HSM, model pinning, and strict PHI controls. Main asks: 1) safety/PHI leakage tests, 2) eval plan including multilingual jitter/adversarial tests, 3) perf target p95 < 450ms at 5 rps for batch size 1, 4) retention policy: ephemeral logs only, 5) guidance on post-quantization accuracy drop and recommended threshold. Do we have any immediate blockers?

Arman (CSM): Thanks @Lena — looping in Eng + Safety. Quick checklist from CSM side:
- Need HSM ARN + VPC CIDR
- Eval bundle: 400 samples across en/de/it + adversarial set
- Renewal note: potential Dedicated expansion if 13B can't meet perf — flagging as upsell risk
- Want an enablement session for their MLops team during canary
Can Citrine provide the eval zip this week?

Diego (SolutionsEng): @Lena a few clarifying Qs:
1) Max sequence len?
2) Are outputs abstractive summaries or extractive/ranked snippets?
3) Do you want multi-turn context (chained docs) preserved?
4) Which quant formats are acceptable (nf4, int8)?

Perf note: 13B on a single H100 node with nf4 usually hits ~p95 250-400ms depending on seq len. At 5rps sustained we'll likely need 2 concurrent instances or batching. If you must stay single-node we can tune batching and KV cache.

Suggested staging config:
```yaml
model: citrine-13b-clinic-v2
private: true
hsm_key: arn:aws:hsm:eu-central-1:222222222222:key/ef12-3456
max_seq: 1536
quant: nf4-4bit
batching: auto-prefix
log_retention_days: 30
safety_profile: phi-mask-v2
```

Talia (Safety): High-level safety items:
- Need PHI schema CSV + examples (patient id, dates, notes granularity)
- We recommend redact+summarize for clinical notes, not abstain, to preserve utility while removing identifiers.
- Eval should include: slot-filling probes, paraphrase prompts, cross-lingual leakage tests, and synthetic PHI injection.
- Must capture a mapping for which fields are allowed in logs (hashes, metadata only).
I'll prepare an adversarial checklist and a scoring rubric.

Lena (CitrineLabs): Answers:
- max_seq 1200 (rarely >1400)
- primary output = abstractive summary + optional highlight list (top 3 sentences)
- single-turn per document, no multi-doc chaining for now
- can accept nf4; int8 preferred if latency improves without >4% quality loss
- I'll upload eval: https://s3.citrine.com/onboard/eval_citrate_v3.zip (contains PHI examples; legal ok under our BAA).

Arman (CSM): Timeline ask from customer: canary in 4 weeks, prod in 9 weeks. They warned that a slip could impact renewal discussion. I'll tag AM and PS for enablement scheduling.

Diego (SolutionsEng): Proposed plan:
Week 1: ingest eval + run baseline quality + hallucination tests (multilang)
Week 2: staging deploy w/ nf4 + perf tuning (measure p95 at target load)
Week 3: adversarial + PHI leakage stress tests with Safety
Week 4: 72h canary at scaled load then handover to PS for enablement
Risks: HSM provisioning lead time, network peering, and dataset transfer for PHI.

infra-bot: Created ticket #INF-9012 for private cluster provisioning (region eu-central-1). ETA 72h for infra stub.

legal-bot: Noted BAA present. Legal will review logging policy and sign-off on ephemeral eval logs. Creating case #LEGAL-567.

Talia (Safety): For metrics we'll report:
- Precision/recall on redaction tags
- Rouge-L / BLEU for summary fidelity per language
- Hallucination rate (false assertions against ground truth)
- Leakage score from injection tests
We'll set acceptance thresholds; recommend: leakage <0.1%, hallucination <2% on critical facts, redaction recall >98% on PHI tokens.

Lena (CitrineLabs): Confirmed HSM ARN shared via secure ticket, eval bundle uploaded, and infra account whitelisted. Token budget approved for perf runs (~150k tokens).

Arman (CSM): I'll schedule the canary kickoff and an enablement workshop for Citine's MLOps team during Week 3. Also recording renewal-risk flag: high if prod >9wks.

Diego (SolutionsEng): I'll start the eval ingestion tomorrow and post run artifacts to the ticket. If perf needs 2 nodes we'll propose Dedicated quote early to avoid timeline slip.

Lena (CitrineLabs): Thanks all — please confirm when infra ticket has IPs and we can run the first ingest. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :pray:
